ideas.title: Investigating Fraud in Social Services
ideas.description: This story would investigate the prevalence of fraud in social services, including the Feeding Our Future scheme and allegations of tax fraud.
questions: How widespread is fraud in social services?
What measures can be taken to prevent fraud in social services?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights a potential vulnerability in the system and could lead to changes in how social services are funded and regulated.
